name: opaque-circuits
description: Canonical Circom circuits for Opaque Cash: V2 stealth_reputation (V1 stealth_attestation retired 2026-06-10).

scripts.setup: snarkjs groth16 setup v2/build/stealth_reputation.r1cs pot16_final.ptau v2/build/stealth_reputation_0000.zkey
scripts.contribute: snarkjs zkey contribute v2/build/stealth_reputation_0000.zkey v2/build/stealth_reputation_final.zkey --name='Opaque V2'
scripts.export-vkey: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey v2/build/stealth_reputation_final.zkey v2/build/verification_key.json
scripts.export-sol: snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier v2/build/stealth_reputation_final.zkey v2/build/Groth16VerifierV2.sol
scripts.prove: snarkjs groth16 prove v2/build/stealth_reputation_final.zkey v2/build/stealth_reputation_js/witness.wtns v2/build/proof.json v2/build/public.json
scripts.verify: snarkjs groth16 verify v2/build/verification_key.json v2/build/public.json v2/build/proof.json
